function: Phase-2 tripod sled: plate with two kite ribs keying into the Apollo fan's tapered base slots, and a 1/4-20 printed-thread boss underneath for any camera tripod

driving_dims.thread: 1/4-20 UNC, modeled, +0.30 mm diametral fit, 5.2 turns

fits.feature: kite rib into tapered base slot

principal_load: tripod screw tension along Z plus hand-tightening torque; fan weight in -Z; lateral nudges in XY taken by the ribs
assumptions: rib fit carried over unchanged from coupon v6 (print #4): gap datum 40.2, clearance 0.15/side, 22 mm ribs
printed 1/4-20 female thread at +0.30 mm diametral allowance threads by hand in PETG at 0.2 mm layers
supports under the plate (7 mm table-top over the boss) are acceptable; underside is non-cosmetic
fan balance point is ~32 mm behind the front edge on the centerline

named_features: 16 mm boss with blind 1/4-20 modeled thread opening downward
